thesis: Savneet Singh argues that Barcelona was undervalued because it had recovered less than other European cities while interest rates remained low, creating an opportunity to capitalize on the underappreciated Airbnb ecosystem where licensed properties offered significantly higher yields. He further contends that Airbnb represents the most impactful new company of the last decade and is already the largest hotel company in the world, with significant growth potential as the next generation of wealth holders enters the market.
